{{Youmay|the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] phrase|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]}}
'''Jabba''' was a term used by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] Internal Affairs division to characterize a situation where an individual was forced to commit a crime. Once an individual had been "Jabba-ed" and charged with the crime, they were given a chance to redeem themselves by executing favors for IA agents.
